Breaking: 'F*** the Pope and the IRA' chant lands England in hot water as fans are given suspended one-game stadium ban and FA fined

📅 19 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (512 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Dailymail

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 13:19 EST, 19 November 2026 | Updated: 03:21 EST, 20 November 2026.
  • UEFA have slapped the FA with a £12,500 fine and a suspended one-match away supporters ban after England fans were heard singing sectarian chants during their Nations League victory over Spain last weekend.
  • Some of the 3,000 supporters who travelled to Madrid were heard singing 'f*** the Pope and the IRA' inside Madrid's Metropolitano Stadium on Sunday.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By BOBBY MANZI, FOOTBALL REPORTER.

Published: 13:19 EST, 19 November 2026 | Updated: 03:21 EST, 20 November 2026.

UEFA have slapped the FA with a £12,500 fine and a suspended one-match away supporters ban after England fans were heard singing sectarian chants during their Nations League victory over Spain last weekend.

Some of the 3,000 supporters who travelled to Madrid were heard singing 'f*** the Pope and the IRA' inside Madrid's Metropolitano Stadium on Sunday.

As a result, UEFA have fined the FA and banned away fans from attending one UEFA match for 'racist and/or discriminatory behaviour'.

That noted, the ban will only take effect if England supporters reoffend within the next two years.

It is a fortunate reprieve given the Three Lions' next away fixture is their Nations League quarter-final, the draw for which is on Friday.

Meanwhile, the FA have committed to identifying those involved and taking action - which could see football banning orders imposed.

In a statement to Daily Mail Sport, the FA mentioned: 'We will not tolerate this unacceptable and deeply offensive chanting, and will work with the police who attend all England home and away matches to identify the perpetrators and take the necessary action.'.

England fans land FA in hot water over 'f*** the Pope and the IRA' chant during Spain victory.

It has been revealed that england supporters have notoriously sung the anti-Catholic and loyalist chant. In 2024, the Irish police urged travelling fans to 'respect local culture' before their Nations League match against the Republic of Ireland.

Fans were also filmed in Milan city centre on the eve of the clash against Italy in 2022 singing the same incendiary chant - just one year after their European Championship final defeat to the Italians.

Sources indicate that meanwhile, then England boss Roy Hodgson and the FA were forced to condemn supporters after the inflammatory chant was heard throughout England's 3-1 friendly victory over Scotland at Celtic Park in 2014. Around 5,000 fans travelled to the devoutly Catholic club.

It has been revealed that the issue is not limited to international football. In August, Daily Mail Sport revealed that Chelsea wrote to supporters after a section of their fans were heard singing the sectarian chant away at Fulham on the opening weekend of the Premier League season.

England boss Thomas Tuchel was asked about racism in his pre-Spain press conference.

'I never expect racism and the dressing room is the most anti-racist place on Earth and that's exactly how it works,' Tuchel remarked.

Sources indicate that 'I expect emotional and of course supporting fans from Spain for their national team. That's what I expect, but I don't expect racism nowhere.

'I'm shocked if it happens, and it should happen nowhere, and I'm the first one to stand up for these kind of values.

'My trust is that we have a friendly atmosphere, that we have an atmosphere who is clearly in favour of the Spanish team, and that football does what it does best: bring people together and not divide people.'.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Nel consueto appuntamento sulle colonne del Corriere della Sera, all’indomani del 4-4 alla Latest Balance Arena il giornalista Domenico Calcagno analizza la sfida tra Atalanta e Inter nel consueto appuntamento con l’editoriale.

According to recent reports, “Nella parte alta della classifica si procede ad altissima velocità. Le prime sei (da ieri c’è la Juve al posto del Frosinone) hanno vinto tutte in scioltezza a parte l’inter, che aveva l’impegno più complicato a Bergamo con l’atalanta. Ed effettivamente la serata dei campioni d’italia è stata complessa”.

“Non sono bastati i tre gol di Esposito, salito a quota 6 in campionato, alla pari con Thuram, perché solo a tratti l’inter è stata perfetta e feroce come contro il Como. Ha giocato un calcio solido creando molto ma soltanto a tratti”.

Industry observers note that “Regolarmente, sul doppio vantaggio, si è fermata lasciando spazio all’atalanta che non si è mai arresa e alla fine ha raggiunto un pareggio che sembrava impossibile. Ha deciso un rigore fischiato al 90’ e trasformato da Kessie per un mani di Bastoni e Chivu può prendersela solo con i suoi, incapaci di tenere costante la concentrazione”.

“Pareggiare a Bergamo ci sta, ma non dopo essere stati avanti 2-0, 3-1 e 4-2. Nel finale è tornato Lautaro, ma alla mezzora si è fermato, per un guaio muscolare, Calhanoglu. Insomma, l’inter ha sprecato e si è pure fatta male” conclude il Corriere della Sera.

According to recent reports, (ANSA) - ROMA, 23 NOV - "Non riesco a vederla in positivo. Diciamoci la verità: i difensori sono un po' scarsi. Certo, ci divertiamo a vedere gol, bisognerebbe tornare a insegnare ai difensori a difendere". Così Massimo Mauro, ex centrocampista di Napoli e Juventus, ospite di Radio Anch'io Sport su Rai Radio 1, sui tanti gol segnati finora in campionato. Lazio capolista solitaria dopo 12 giornate?: "Ci sta stupendo tutti, meirta un giudizio positivo sul suo futuro. Mi farebbe molto piacere che quest'anno ci fosse un'altra squadra a lottare per lo scudetto. E mi riferisco anche alla Roma. Le due romane riescono a essere equilibrate tra fase difensiva e offensiva". Poi Mauro parla dell'effetto Malen nella lotta scudetto: "Non voglio sminuire il valore di Malen, ma mi piace mettere al centro il gioco della Roma. Esempio: ieri in Juve-Venezia Kolo Muani ha toccato il pallone due volte in tutto il primo tempo, Malen in un tempo quasi si stufa per quanti palloni ha a disposizione. Gasperini è sempre stato una garanzia, i suoi centravanti hanno fatto tanti gol.

Recent findings suggest that la Roma ha anche una difesa straordinaria. la squadra ha equilibrio. Se Dybala regge, può lottare fino alla fine per lo scudetto". Infine la sfida Malagò-Galliani, verso il 14 dicembre: "Le scelte di Malagò finora mi sono piaciute, ha formato una squadra su cui si può avere fiducia. Galliani è stato il dirigente più bravo che il calcio italiano ha avuto, insieme con Giraudo. Adesso Adriano è vecchietto, non mi aspettavo questa candidatura. In Italia, i vecchietti non vogliono fare i saggi, vogliono continuare ad avere potere e questa cosa non è buona. Non so come andrà a finire, ma finora Malagò ha fatto tutto molto bene, fatta eccezione per la sceneggiata Guardiola. La Lega Serie A - conclude Mauro - è peggio del peggior condominio, avere a che fare con tutti i presidnete di Serie A è difficilissimo. Quello è il problema". (ANSA).

Chelsea are great entertainers but possess clear weakness

📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways

  • But perhaps the most significant numbers are around how much – or how little – Chelsea are having the ball.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Chelsea are promising to be this season’s Premier League entertainers and yet manager Xabi Alonso seemingly believes less is more when it comes to possession.

Alonso has started with two wins from two league games in charge of Chelsea, with his team scoring seven goals and conceding five. So far, it has been a lot of fun – if not entirely convincing.

But perhaps the most significant numbers are around how much – or how little – Chelsea are having the ball. Having finished their 3-2 victory over Fulham with 38.11 per cent of possession, Chelsea had just 25.6 per cent in the 4-3 success over Brighton and Hove Albion and successfully completed 146 passes. Both were their lowest figures on record in the Premier League.

Recent findings suggest that “The data is not notable,” Alonso said. “It’s how you play and what we can do better. I don’t say ‘today we need to have 60 per cent or 20 per cent’. I never talk about those things. It’s about how to prepare, how to be more competitive.”.

Recent findings suggest that chelsea’s third goal against Brighton, scored in the 32nd minute, best summed up the London club under Alonso to date. It took the home side three passes to go from the edge of their own penalty area to João Pedro scoring against his former club.

According to recent reports, jorrel Hato passed the ball to Morgan Rogers, he then released Hato down the left and the wing-back slid the ball across for João Pedro to finish. It was a devastating counter-attack and should have put Chelsea on course for a much easier win.

Joao Pedro finishes off a deadly Chelsea counter-attack and gives the Blues a 3-0 lead 🔥 pic.twitter.com/wAr0ckIgXJ.

“After 30 minutes, we are 3-0 and probably, in that moment, we have played too much the result,” Alonso mentioned. “It’s quite normal, it happens in many teams. I am sure in the future we can manage it better.”.

Industry observers note that it is one thing outscoring Fulham and a depleted Brighton team without having the ball, but can Chelsea do that against the bigger and better teams? We will get an early indicator in the next game against Arsenal at the Emirates.

In a recent development, alonso’s approach has some similarities to the way in which Antonio Conte set up his Chelsea title-winning team. Just as Conte converted Victor Moses into an effective right wing-back, Alonso started Pedro Neto there on Sunday.

After Roméo Lavia had opened the scoring, it was Neto who grabbed Chelsea’s second goal against Brighton by drifting into the penalty area to finish from Rogers’s low cross.

"It's a nightmare for the goalkeeper!"Bart Verbruggen and Mats Wieffer's collision leads to Romeo Lavia scoring his first goal for Chelsea ⚽️ pic.twitter.com/q5awbdwVV0.

In a recent development, "Pedro Neto Pounces!"Morgan Rogers goes past his defender before sliding the ball across to Neto! 💥 pic.twitter.com/WHZCIGsOLl.

But whereas Conte’s team gave up little at the back, Alonso’s Chelsea are yet to balance their effective transitional play with shutting out their opponents.

Sources indicate that neto was partly to blame for Brighton’s first goal, as he missed a challenge in the build-up to Malick Yalcouyé’s brilliant volley. Making his Chelsea debut, goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez could do nothing to stop it and can expect to be kept busy this season if things do not change.

It has been revealed that “I have come here to challenge and to try and win the Premier League,” Martínez stated. “I know the talent we have up front. I try to bring that solidity at the back.”.

"Yalcouye with a sumptuous volley!"Malick Yalcouye puts Brighton on the scoreboard with a venomous volley 😳 pic.twitter.com/8UeeyvPjUw.

Sources indicate that conte’s Chelsea had N’Golo Kanté to mop up in midfield and that is an area of the pitch that is causing Alonso some difficulties. Manchester City target Enzo Fernández was once again left out of the squad and Moisés Caicedo was not deemed fit enough to start.

Caicedo was eventually thrown on when Chelsea were trying to stop Brighton completing a remarkable comeback, but he was quickly forced off again with an injury. The club have been exploring a move for Monaco midfielder Lamine Camara and that need looks even more pressing now.

According to recent reports, “We want the best for the team and that’s why we took a decision [on Fernández] against Luton and today,” Alonso remarked. “What’s going to develop? We’re not sure. We can prepare. We are preparing for all the scenarios. But I assure you that whatever happens, from Wednesday [when the transfer window is shut] we’ll have a good enough squad to compete in all the Premier League games.”.

Chelsea’s fresh set-piece coach Austin MacPhee had celebrated Lavia’s goal, which came partly as a result of a corner but owed more to a mistake from Brighton goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen.

It has been revealed that macPhee, however, will not have liked Brighton’s second-half goals. It was from a short corner that the visitors managed to work the ball to Pascal Gross and his cross was diverted into his own net by João Pedro.

Joao Pedro puts Pascal Groß's cross into his own net and Brighton have brought it back to 3-2 👀 pic.twitter.com/maBMwVu3DC.

Gross’s headed third goal also came at the end of a set-piece, but, fortunately for Chelsea, it was in the sixth minute of added time and Cole Palmer had already made the points safe for the home team before then.

Palmer had done little to impress watching England head coach Thomas Tuchel until he picked up the ball in the 74th minute, shrugged off two Brighton challenges and produced a brilliant finish to beat Verbruggen.

Cole Palmer finishes EXPERTLY to give Chelsea their two-goal cushion back 💥 pic.twitter.com/6xI9W8xe2q.

Fabian Hürzeler, the Brighton manager, noted his team “dominated” the game, but acknowledged: “I think if you spend so much money on these kinds of players, like Rogers, Palmer or João [Pedro], then, of course, a team like Chelsea can rely on this individual quality. And they indicated it in certain moments of the game.”.

Palmer, João Pedro and Rogers are clearly going to be a huge problem for Chelsea’s opponents. But Alonso’s team cannot rely on having to score three or four goals to win games. And they might need to have a bit more of the ball.

"The game today was a special game for me." João Pedro says he was happy with his performance for Chelsea against Brighton 🔵 pic.twitter.com/fWSqWo7ert.

Recent findings suggest that 6 - João Pedro today was the sixth player (and first for Chelsea) to score a goal, assist a goal, and score an own goal in the same Premier League game, and first since Tottenham Hotspur's Son Heung-min against Man City in December 2023.Eventful. pic.twitter.com/xRVjqkOY9D.

The final game of the day comes from the north west as Manchester United host newly-promoted Ipswich. That game kicks off at 4.30pm and you can follow all the live action from that match right here.

Chelsea 4 Brighton 3 Leeds 1 Brentford 1 Sunderland 1 Fulham 0.

Possession: Chelsea 26%-74% BrightonShots: 17-15Shots on target: 6-6Corners: 4-7Touches in opposition box: 29-28.

In a recent development, there is no time for Brighton to push for the equaliser as the final whistle is blown at Stamford Bridge. Chelsea make it two wins from two to start the latest Premier League season but were pushed all the way by Brighton. It finishes 4-3 at Stamford Bridge.

It has been revealed that it could well be the last touch of the game but Brighton have a small amount of hope as Gross heads past Martinez. If that had come a few minutes ago, maybe Brighton could have pushed for a draw.

Brighton have a corner and if they are to have any chance of potentially rescuing a point, they have to score right now. De Cuyper’s inswinger is clipped into a dangerous area but for some odd reason referee Michael Oliver gives Chelsea a free-kick. Absolutely ridiculous decision; there was no foul in any way, shape or form.

Chelsea look to counter through Pedro, who is then brought down by Costinha. It is an easy booking for referee Michael Oliver to give.

How many added minutes will there be? The answer is five minutes.

Boscagli is booked for bringing down Rogers.

This is a concern for Chelsea as Caicedo, who came on as a second-half substitute, is now having to go off injured. In his place is former Brighton man Barco, who slapped Bellingham at the World Cup. Barco is booed vociferously by the travelling Brighton fans.

Meanwhile Leeds are level 1-1 against Brentford at Elland Road thanks to Calvert-Lewin’s equaliser.

Double change for Brighton as Costinha and David replace Wieffer and Kostoulas.

Brighton scored four a week ago against Aston Villa on the opening weekend but have conceded four this weekend. If they can get a goal though soon, it would make the home fans inside Stamford Bridge very nervous.

Kadioglu has an effort from the edge of the Chelsea box but drags his effort wide.

Meanwhile, up in the north east, Isidor has put Sunderland 1-0 up against Fulham at the Stadium of Light.

Palmer has been pretty quiet today but Chelsea’s two-goal lead is restored. He receives it from Pedro and drives forward through the Brighton half. As he approaches the edge of the penalty area, Palmer calmly slots home into the bottom corner.

Cole Palmer finishes EXPERTLY to give Chelsea their two-goal cushion back 💥 pic.twitter.com/6xI9W8xe2q.

Tuchel will have like that. He may not have had a brilliant game, but Palmer just scored a brilliant goal. That should be enough for Chelsea.

Fabian Hurzeler turns to his bench for the first time today as Osman comes on for Yalcouye, who was impressive.

Xabi Alonso turns to his bench again as Chavarria replaces Colwill.

We have this news from the Premier League:.

#CHEBHAMatch Officials are operating in the second half without communications packs due to an ongoing technical concern. VAR remains in operation via a back-up system using messages sent to the referee's watch and radio communication to the fourth official if required.

Industry observers note that dunk is in trouble. The ball is played forward by Gusto down the right channel to pick out the run of Pedro into the Brighton half. Dunk brings Pedro down but is fortunate that Vuskovic was covering so that is why there is no red card. Dunk is rightly booked.

It has been revealed that chelsea are on the ropes at the moment and Brighton can sense another goal. Boscagli is the latest Brighton player to have an effort and Martinez is forced into a decent save down to his left.

Sources indicate that xabi Alonso is going to respond to the Brighton momentum with a triple change. James, Acheampong and Caicedo replace Neto, Lavia and Fofana.

Recent findings suggest that it is all Brighton and Chelsea are seriously wobbling. Gomez has his fourth chance of the second half and is not far off scoring as his effort hits the side netting. You can sense the anxiety inside Stamford Bridge and it is the travelling Brighton fans making all the noise.

Sources indicate that this game is well and truly back on. Chelsea looked in complete control at 3-0 up but now there is just one goal in it. Brighton work a corner short and appear to have wasted the chance but Yalcouye slides a wonderful pass into the right side of the box to pick out the run of Gross, whose shot/cross takes a significant deflection off former Brighton man Pedro and goes past Martinez into the Chelsea net.

Joao Pedro puts Pascal Groß's cross into his own net and Brighton have brought it back to 3-2 👀 pic.twitter.com/maBMwVu3DC.

It has been revealed that gomez has already missed two chances in this second half and he now has his third opportunity since the break. His powerful effort from the right side of the box forces Martinez into a decent save at his near post...

England head coach Thomas Tuchel is at Stamford Bridge today. He won’t have like Cole Palmer’s miss much and Palmer is probably the only Chelsea attacking player not to have impressed so far. There’s still time, though.

Chelsea have two big chances to score a fourth but cannot take either. First, Neto takes advantage of poor defending from Kadioglu and has a shot saved at the near post by Verbruggen. Then Palmer has a glorious opportunity inside the six-yard box from Rogers’ cross but somehow Palmer guides it over the bar. I am going to say it now that I do not think we have seen an end to the goals today.

Fofana is rightly booked for an earlier challenge on De Cuyper as he completely took him out and Brighton now have a free-kick deep into the Chelsea half after a foul by Neto.

In a recent development, boscagli clips a lovely free-kick to the back post, where he perfectly picks out Gomez, who has a free header from the edge of the six-yard box but his powerful header goes wide of the far post. That should have been a goal and that is a mighty let-off for Chelsea.

Gomez has a decent chance for Brighton on the edge of the Chelsea penalty area but he fires his effort well wide.

Sources indicate that chelsea attack from back to front, with Martinez launching a long ball forward from inside his own box to pick out the run of Pedro into the Brighton half. Pedro ends up having a shot blocked inside the Brighton penalty area.

Palmer was very influential for Chelsea at Fulham on Monday night and, despite Chelsea scoring three first-half goals, he has been quiet today.

We are back under way at Stamford Bridge. Despite Chelsea being two goals ahead, it does not feel like Brighton are out of this one.

Chelsea 3 Brighton 1Leeds 0 Brentford 1Sunderland 0 Fulham 0.

Possession: Chelsea 29%-71% BrightonShots: 9-6Shots on target: 4-3Corners: 2-4Touches in opposition box: 15-10.

Chelsea go in 3-1 at half-time, having only had 29.3 per cent of possession. They finished with about 35 per cent possession in the 3-2 victory over Fulham, so it seems Alonso is setting his team up very much as a counter-attacking side. It’s all very Antonio Conte.

Vuskovic has a late effort in the first half from range and it goes just over Martinez’s bar.

The first half is then brought to an end not long after and Chelsea take a 3-1 lead into the break.

The Brighton fans enjoy an audacious Pedro backheel that does not come off. Moments later, Gross clips in a cross from the right that picks out Gomez in the box but his header goes over the bar.

There will be two added minutes at the end of this first half.

There has been a goal in one of the other 2pm kick-offs. At Elland Road, Brentford, who were one of the most impressive teams on the opening weekend, have taken the lead over Leeds through Schade.

After a dreadful clearance from Dunk, Rogers shoots from just outside the box but it goes wide of Verbruggen’s left post.

Pedro has a shot blocked inside the Brighton area before Rogers also has an effort blocked.

According to recent reports, at 3-0 down, they looked down and out but maybe the visitors have a route back into the game. Kostoulas is denied by Martinez before the ball comes to Yalcouye, who volleys first time. His emphatic effort smashes off the inside of the far post and into the net. A fine way to score your first Premier League goal and maybe this game is not over quite yet.

"Yalcouye with a sumptuous volley!"Malick Yalcouye puts Brighton on the scoreboard with a venomous volley 😳 pic.twitter.com/8UeeyvPjUw.

There have already been three goals in the first half at Stamford Bridge but it is still goalless at Elland Road and the Stadium of Light in the other two 2pm kick-offs.

The Brighton fans have been singing ‘The Falklands are ours’ at Chelsea’s Argentine substitute Valentin Barco. Barco was part of the Argentina squad who celebrated his nation’s World Cup win over England by displaying a Falklands banner. The Brighton fans had also been giving the club’s former striker Joao Pedro some stick. Pedro celebrated his goal right in front of them. Touche.

In a recent development, the Brazilian missed a sitter earlier but he makes no mistake this time and goes to celebrate in front of the travelling Brighton fans. Pedro owes a lot of gratitude from Hato, who drives down Chelsea’s left from inside his own half to the edge of the Brighton box. The Dutchman passes to his left to find Pedro, who takes one touch before clinically slotting home into the far corner. Is that game, set and match?

Joao Pedro finishes off a deadly Chelsea counter-attack and gives the Blues a 3-0 lead 🔥 pic.twitter.com/wAr0ckIgXJ.

Brighton have their first real sighter on goal. Gomez clips in a lovely delivery to the far post to pick out the run of Yalcouye into the box. Yalcouye gets to it on the stretch and his effort is straight at Martinez.

It has been revealed that brighton have had 70% possession but their xG right now sits at 0.03. Despite having a lot of the ball, they really have not looked like scoring. You do though have to bear in mind that they are without forwards like Minteh, Rutter and Mitoma due to injury. Will Minteh still be a Brighton player when the window shuts?

How has Pedro missed? The former Brighton man absolutely should have put Chelsea 3-0 up and that could have been game, set and match. The ball is played in behind down the right channel and Neto outmuscles Kadioglu, who goes to ground near the byline. Neto then unselfishly from the right side of the box squares it for Pedro, who takes a few touches before getting his shot away. It seems harder to miss than to score but somehow puts his effort wide of the far post.

After Martinez easily catches a corner from Gross, the Chelsea fans start singing the name of their newly introduced goalkeeper.

Brighton are dominating posession but are yet to have a shot. Chelsea meanwhile have had three shots, all on target, and have scored twice.

Sources indicate that the hosts have their second inside the opening quarter of an hour. Rogers does well on the left side of the box to hold off Vuskovic before squaring the ball. Neto runs across Kadioglu’s blindside and pokes home first time from eight yards out. Kadioglu should really have dealt with that and was too flat-footed. He should not have allowed Neto to get to that ball first.

"Pedro Neto Pounces!"Morgan Rogers goes past his defender before sliding the ball across to Neto! 💥 pic.twitter.com/WHZCIGsOLl.

The travelling Brighton fans are making sure that Pedro knows what they think of their former player.

Up in the stands, England boss Thomas Tuchel is sat next to Brazil manager Carlo Ancelotti, both former Chelsea bosses.

Since the start of the 2024/25 season, no goalkeeper in the Premier League has made more errors leading to goals than Verbruggen’s 10. Second on that list; Sanchez, who is not in the Chelsea squad today.

Brighton win their first corner of the afternoon and Martinez is forced into action, punching away at his near post as the delivery threatened to creep in.

It has been revealed that that is an absolute gift for the home side after a huge error from Brighton. Pedro flicks on at the near post and Wieffer makes the block near his own line. Verbruggen then tries to catch the loose ball but he and Wieffer end up getting into each others’ way. The ball then falls to Lavia, who pokes home. As they did at Craven Cottage the other night, Chelsea hit the front early.

"It's a nightmare for the goalkeeper!"Bart Verbruggen and Mats Wieffer's collision leads to Romeo Lavia scoring his first goal for Chelsea ⚽️ pic.twitter.com/q5awbdwVV0.

Sources indicate that there was a fist pump from Chelsea’s upcoming set-piece coach Austin MacPhee after Romeo Lavia’s goal from the corner. It looks like MacPhee will be claiming credit for that one, even though it came thanks to an error from Brighton goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen. Xabi Alonso also celebrated with MacPhee.

Chelsea win the first corner of the afternoon after Dunk blocked Neto’s cross...

He might be trying to sell his shares in Chelsea, but co-owner Todd Boehly is at today’s game in the Stamford Bridge stands.

Before we get going, Stamford Bridge pays tribute to Bobby Tambling and Ken Bates, who both died over the summer. Wreaths are laid in their memory with their families carrying framed pictures of the two men.

We then get under way in west London.

Both sides emerge from the tunnel at Stamford Bridge and we are moments away from kick-off in west London. Here is a reminder of how the two sides line up this afternoon:.

Chelsea: Martinez, Fofana, Lacroix, Colwill, Neto, Gusto, Lavia, Hato, Palmer, Rogers, Joao Pedro.Substitutes: Penders, James, Acheampong, Chavarria, Caicedo, Barco, Gittens, Estevao, Welbeck.

Brighton: Verbruggen, Wieffer, Boscagli, Dunk, Vuskovic, Gross, Gomez, De Cuyper, Kadioglu, Yalcouye, Kostoulas.Substitutes: Steele, Struijk, Hadjam, Promise, Osman, Costinha, Cozier-Duberry, O’Riley, Oriola.

As you’d expect, there were massive cheers for Emi Martinez from the Chelsea fans ahead of kick-off. He responded by shaking a fist in the air and giving them a big round of applause. This is his first game since the World Cup final for Argentina.

Industry observers note that chelsea had gone 77 League games without fielding a player aged 30 plus before handing goalkeeper Emi Martinez a debut today. The Argentine celebrates his 34th birthday on September 2. The last played aged 30-plus to appear for the club was Thiago Silva, who was 39 at the time.

“We are delighted to have him. To have a goalkeeper of his stature, his personality, I think he will bring a lot of qualities. I am sure he can have a straight impact. We spoke, he felt ready to play, so here we go.”.

On Robert Sanchez being left out:.

Sources indicate that “We will see. It was a decision we thought was good for the team, for the club. Sometimes you have to take tough decisions because this one is an important one. But now we need to look forward.”.

On Enzo Fernandez being left out of the matchday squad:.

“We assess what is best for the team and considering everything, the situation, we need a team that is focused, with everyone involved that is fully committed and engaged with the game.”.

Emiliano Martínez turns 34 on September 2 and by most tangible metrics, the goalkeeper is past his peak.

But it is the intangibles that set Martínez apart and why his availability at a knock-down price from Aston Villa convinced Chelsea to seize a market opportunity.

At £7.5m, Martínez could prove to be Chelsea’s smartest piece of business of the summer and there is little doubt he will be box-office at Stamford Bridge.

Chelsea: Martinez, Fofana, Lacroix, Colwill, Neto, Gusto, Lavia, Hato, Palmer, Rogers, Joao Pedro.Substitutes: Penders, James, Acheampong, Chavarria, Caicedo, Barco, Gittens, Estevao, Welbeck.

“I am delighted to be at this football club,” Martinez noted. “Coming to Chelsea, for me and my family, was an easy decision to make and I am just over the moon; I cannot wait to get started.

It has been revealed that “I want to be successful here. I am someone who wants to win at everything I do and I want to bring that here to this football club because it is a football club that wins titles, so I think it is a good match. I am all passion and I play with my heart. I will give 100 per cent every game, every training session to make the club, my teammates and the supporters proud.”.

Sources indicate that xabi Alonso takes charge of his first home Premier League game in charge of Chelsea as they host Brighton at Stamford Bridge. Both sides were in action in two different competitions on Thursday night. Chelsea reached the League Cup third round as they beat Luton 2-0 at Stamford Bridge, with former Brighton man Danny Welbeck scoring on his debut. Brighton meanwhile confirmed their place in the Conference League group stages with a 4-0 aggregate win over Tromso.

It has been revealed that chelsea began their Premier League campaign last Monday in a west London derby against Fulham at Craven Cottage, winning 3-2 in Alonso’s first game as Chelsea boss. Enzo Fernandez was not involved in Chelsea’s squad against Luton on Thursday and has been heavily linked with a move to Manchester City. Alonso was asked about Enzo’s absence on Thursday and did not confirm whether the Argentine would be involved today.

“It was just because of the game today [on Thursday] and we have other players who need minutes,” Alonso stated. “[On Wednesday], in the afternoon. It is a decision that I took. Enzo is a good professional. He is training well and I have nothing to say about this. It was just decisions that we have to take thinking about the game that we were playing tonight [Thursday]. We will see for Sunday [today].”.

Sources indicate that brighton began their Premier League campaign in emphatic style as they thrashed Aston Villa 4-0 at home seven days ago. Jack Hinshelwood scored twice in that game but will now miss a number of weeks with an ankle injury. They are also without Yankuba Minteh, who has been linked with a move to Liverpool this summer but is unavailable due to injury.

“When the window is closed I demand from him [Minteh] that he is fully committed to this club,” Brighton boss Fabian Hurzeler said. “There are dreams and wishes for players, but in the end we always need to figure out what is best for the club.

According to recent reports, “We have had an exchange with him. At the moment he is definitely a Brighton player. It is very crucial to understand his thoughts but also our planning. As a club we try to develop players. The last few years have shown that the whole environment gave him a lot of trust and belief that he is capable of having this progress. It is always a give and take and he has gotten a lot from us.”.

Recent findings suggest that brighton won both Premier League meetings last season, winning 3-1 in this fixture last September. Brighton have won five of their last eight top-flight meetings with Chelsea. Team news from Stamford Bridge to follow shortly.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Paolo Di Canio durissimo nei confronti di Benjamin Pavard dopo il pareggio per 4-4 tra Atalanta e Inter.
  • L'episodio contestato è quello dell'81', quando il belga ha riportato l'Atalanta sul 3-4 con una conclusione potente terminata sotto la traversa della porta difesa da Josep Martinez.
  • Secondo Di Canio, Pavard avrebbe dovuto opporsi al tiro con maggiore determinazione, invece di girarsi nel tentativo di proteggersi dalla pallonata.

Paolo Di Canio durissimo nei confronti di Benjamin Pavard dopo il pareggio per 4-4 tra Atalanta e Inter. L'ex attaccante, intervenuto negli studi di Sky Sport, ha criticato pesantemente l'atteggiamento del difensore francese in occasione della seconda rete realizzata da Charles De Ketelaere.

L'episodio contestato è quello dell'81', quando il belga ha riportato l'Atalanta sul 3-4 con una conclusione potente terminata sotto la traversa della porta difesa da Josep Martinez.

Secondo Di Canio, Pavard avrebbe dovuto opporsi al tiro con maggiore determinazione, invece di girarsi nel tentativo di proteggersi dalla pallonata.

Parole pesantissime quelle dell'ex attaccante, che individua nella mancanza di aggressività difensiva uno degli errori principali di Pavard. Di Canio contesta soprattutto il movimento con cui il francese ha provato a opporsi alla conclusione di De Ketelaere, sostenendo che il tentativo di evitare l'impatto diretto con il pallone abbia finito per penalizzare anche Martinez.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 06:33 EST, 19 November 2026 | Updated: 04:07 EST, 20 November 2026.
  • Mauricio Pochettino has vowed to reset the culture at Manchester United as he lifted the lid on being in the stands in 1999 to see the club's greatest triumph.
  • Pochettino was officially appointed as United's upcoming head coach on Wednesday and took charge of training for the first time on Thursday.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By NATHAN SALT - FOOTBALL REPORTER.

Published: 06:33 EST, 19 November 2026 | Updated: 04:07 EST, 20 November 2026.

Mauricio Pochettino has vowed to reset the culture at Manchester United as he lifted the lid on being in the stands in 1999 to see the club's greatest triumph.

Pochettino was officially appointed as United's upcoming head coach on Wednesday and took charge of training for the first time on Thursday.

The Argentine was pictured greeting his upcoming squad, with several stars having returned from international duty, before attentions turned to preparing the Red Devils for Sunday's trip to Anfield.

Pochettino also addressed the club's internal media team for the first time, outlining how he looks to drag this underperforming squad up the table.

'The culture is the most notable,' Pochettino explained.

'Create the habits, the principles, and I think that is what we want to create.

Mauricio Pochettino took Man United first team training for the first time on Thursday.

Matheus Cunha and Lisandro Martinez were among those to report back after international duty.

Man United will hope to hit the ground running under Pochettino when they face Liverpool on Sunday.

'We need to [be] looking forward and to find a way to create the best habits and the culture that makes us to be close to winning every single game.'.

'The players need to express their talent. We need to create the environment and the platform for the players to perform. That is the most important thing and that is our priority now – it's to work with them and try to take the pressure.'.

Pochettino's determination to be the man to bring winning football back to Old Trafford is in large part due to one of his founding memories of the club back in 1999 when he was a player at Espanyol.

Alongside his now trusted goalkeeper coach Toni Jimenez, Pochettino was at the Nou Camp to see United clinch the Champions League, thus sealing a famous Treble, against Bayern Munich.

'In 1999, I was in Barcelona for that final. That was an iconic final,' he added.

Recent findings suggest that 'Toni Jimenez [was there] too. We were shouting for Manchester United from there. I was so excited to see Manchester United.

'This [is the] type of game that you stay sitting in your place [for] and you're so excited because you are watching the game. That was an amazing game.

Industry observers note that 'And then what happened in the end... it's like it's impossible not to empathise with that team, no?

'That was an amazing memory that made me pay more attention to United, to [Sir Alex] Ferguson and the players that were there, that are all legends.'.

That level of success feels a lifetime away from the current squad, which emerges from the international break for a trip to face bitter rivals Liverpool at Anfield slumped 18th in the Premier League.

Pochettino wants to focus on the potential of his Man United squad, rather than their current Premier League plight.

Pochettino is determined to shift the culture at Manchester United back to winning.

The Argentine head coach was in the stands in Barcelona cheering for United back in 1999.

While there are those who may be daunted trying to turn around the ship which sunk so far it cost Michael Carrick his job, Pochettino wants to focus on potential, rather than the present.

It has been revealed that 'It's a mistake to see the [current] situation. We need to see the potential of this club,' a defiant Pochettino added.

Sources indicate that 'Of course, the circumstances are the circumstances, and we need to be responsible for the circumstances. But at the same time, we need to understand that it's a game and, to connect with the game, we need to feel free.

In a recent development, 'The players need to express their talent. We need to create the environment and the platform for the players to perform. That is the most vital thing and that is our priority now – it's to work with them and try to take the pressure [off].

'Pressure needs to bring energy, responsibility needs to bring energy. Because if not, it's too heavy to put all that pressure and responsibility on your back.

'When you connect with the game, you connect through your talent and when you feel freedom, when you feel happy, when you want to play for your team-mates, when you want to play for your family, when you want to play for your club, your fans.

In a recent development, 'That is what we need to create all together and I think we have an amazing staff - we were talking a lot today. Then [we need to] settle all the principles and the ideas and to create our own philosophy and start from zero.

'I think with the power of this club and the fans supporting us, I think we will get in the place that we deserve to be.'.

Pochettino touched down in Manchester on Wednesday morning after his overnight flight.

Pochettino poses at his unveiling with United director of football Jason Wilcox on Wednesday.

Recent findings suggest that pochettino knows that time is not on his side ahead of an upcoming week that sees United travel to face Liverpool on Sunday, followed by a Champions League trip to face Sporting Lisbon on Wednesday. The week is rounded out by a home match a week on Saturday against Brentford.

The Argentine head coach touched down in Manchester on Wednesday morning, taking a private jet straight after the final whistle of United States versus Haiti in Cincinnati.

Sources indicate that from there he immediately headed to their Carrington training base where he took a tour and met players and staff, including Tom Heaton, Luke Shaw, Mason Mount and Bruno Fernandes. It is understood he left a good first impression on the players.

And yet, in spite of such a packed schedule, which saw him leave Carrington very late at night on Wednesday and reappear bright and early on Thursday for training, Pochettino is raring to go and is eager for his players to head to Anfield on Sunday convinced they can win.

'I have plenty of energy. It's a privilege to be head coach of Manchester United,' he stated.

'And we are not wasting time. We need to be ready to compete on Sunday.

Sources indicate that 'Now it's not time to think about rest, it's not time to think about sleep. It's about being ready and to prepare everything to be sure that we are going to compete in the best condition at Anfield.'.

Un breve estratto delle sue considerazioni:.

“Solo i grandi artisti fanno certe cose, e Modrić ha messo quel pallone: è stato solo l'inizio di questa galleria, di questa galleria degli Uffizi, di questo, io lo paragono spesso Musée d'Orsay, Louvre, Guggenheim, scegliete voi il museo, perché veramente ci sono state tante opere d'arte questa sera, esaltate, create, dipinte da Modrić, da Rabiot, da Diego Moreira, da Pulisic. Industry observers note that "Belle sensazioni, ma non è solo il risultato: anche il discorso di continuità nel corso dei 90 minuti della partita, ma ora la testa alla prossima. Eravamo stanchi, eppure il Frosinone continuava nelle sue transizioni, ma siamo riusciti a controllare bene. Avremmo potuto anche fare più gol, forse nella fase centrale del primo tempo abbiamo sofferto un pochino e dobbiamo migliorare nell'uno contro uno in fase difensiva, ma comunque sì, bella serata per noi stasera".

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Il risultato della gara tra Atalanta e Inter, valevole per la dodicesima giornata di Serie A.

Atalanta ed Inter si sfidano alla Upcoming Balance Arena per il 12° turno di Serie A. I nerazzurri hanno l'obiettivo di accorciare sulla Lazio in classifica, mentre i bergamaschi vogliono proseguire la striscia di vittorie dopo il successo contro il Monza prima della sosta per le nazionali. Ora, dopo i successi di Lazio e Roma, la squadra di Chivu ha una sola scelta: vincere.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

L’Inter parte subito con grande personalità e trova il vantaggio al 16‘, sbloccando il risultato con Pio Esposito. Ma non finisce qui: io classe 2005 trova poco dopo la doppietta sugli sviluppi di un calcio d’angolo. La risposta dell’Atalanta non si fa attendere: al 35’ è Elmas il protagonista della riapertura dei conti alla Latest Balance Arena. Termina sul momentaneo 1-2 il risultato a fine primo tempo.

Nella ripresa succede di tutto. Il secondo tempo si apre nuovamente con il segno dell’Inter. Ancora Pio Esposito, che firma la sua personale tripletta, grazie al ripartenza dei nerazzurri diretta da Thuram. La partita però non si è conclusa al 56’ von l’attaccante di Castellammare di Stabia. La Dea non si arrende e rientra in partita con De Keteleare al 72’, che riaccende momentaneamente le speranze di Maurizio Sarri fino al 2-4 dell’Inter con la rete di Sucic tre minuti dopo. Ma l'Atalanta non molla e nel giro di dieci minuti ristabilisce i conti prima con De Keteleare e poi con Kessie su calcio di rigore. Termina 4-4 al New Balance Arena dopo una partita ricca di emozioni.

“Milan stellare, cinque vittorie nelle ultime sei partite, una posizione in classifica sempre più invitante che accarezza i sogni, le ambizioni di Cardinale, il lavoro di Amorim, l'esaltazione di alcune stelle, uno su tutti Rabiot, senza dimenticare Modric, a costo di essere ripetitivo. Recent findings suggest that "Abbiamo ancora molta strada da fare. Ma in ogni partita vogliamo vedere dei miglioramenti. Questo weekend è stato molto interessante se guardi il tipo di risultati che ci sono stati. Si può vedere che qualcosa sta cambiando in Serie A. Sono stato molto contento di vederci non solo vincere, ma vincere con quel margine. E, quindi, dobbiamo costruirci sopra, ma come dice Amorim, ogni partita è qualcosa su cui costruire e abbiamo molta strada da fare. It has been revealed that il Milan Futuro torna alla grande dalla sosta delle Nazionali e vince 3-0 contro la Tritium, in occasione della tredicesima giornata del girone B di Serie D che si è giocata allo stadio "Felice Chinetti" di Solbiate Arno. Decisivi, per la formazione di Sergio Navarro, gli attaccanti Levis Asanji, autore di una doppietta, e Lorenzo Ossola, che ha segnato il secondo dei tre gol. Al termine della gara, ai microfoni del club, hanno parlato due dei protagonisti: Damir Zukic e El Hadji Malick Cissé.

Industry observers note that le dichiarazioni di Zukic: "Proviamo in ogni partita a non subire gol e oggi ci siamo riusciti, ma la cosa più importante è aver vinto e conquistato i tre puntiò. Il Mister ha costruito un gruppo forte, per cui quello che conta di più è divertirsi, essere una famiglia e aiutarsi a vicenda. Ora ci aspetta un mese difficile, nel quale giocheremo quasi una partita ogni tre giorni: sarà importante affrontarle una alla volta".

In a recent development, le parole di Malick Cissé: "Oggi abbiamo fatto una bella partita. Al Milan sto benissimo e i miei compagni mi aiutano molto: sono davvero felice di essere qui".

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Published: 12:00 EST, 18 November 2026 | Updated: 04:24 EST, 20 November 2026.

The man parked up in a nondescript green Ford Fiesta cut an incongruous sight in the affluent residential neighbourhood of Casal Palocco, in south-west Rome, but no one paid him much notice. He made no eye contact and at no stage stepped from the car.

It was only after the street’s famous resident, AS Roma’s Belgian midfielder Radja Nainggolan, had his home burgled and an extraordinary £400,000 worth of possessions stolen that the player’s then wife, Claudia, six months pregnant at that time in April 2016, recalled the Eastern European-looking man in the battered vehicle up their street.

He was Vlada Djuric, a 50-year-old Macedonian of Romani descent and part of the wider Nikolov family, including his wife Zora Jovanovic, their two sons and daughter, whose highly organised thefts from the homes of top footballers would continue for more than a decade, with imprisonment deemed only a minor setback.

While the Nainggolans were blithely unaware of the criminal family’s lookout man – they’d gone to visit friends nearby for a couple of hours and hadn't even bothered to activate the burglar alarm – the assailants were primed to seize the chance.

The two sons, Valentino and Giacomo, mounted the villa’s perimeter wall, opening one door with a magnetic card and jimmying another with a screwdriver, and proceeded undisturbed through the house in 27 minutes, throwing the proceeds of their burglary into a bag as they went.

In a recent development, there were 15 watches (Rolex, Patek Philippe and others) valued at £250,000 and 20 pieces of jewellery, including a diamond worth £25,000. Security cameras on a landing and in an internal room filmed them but such was their confidence, they only partially covered their faces.

Former Roma midfielder Radja Nainggolan and his then wife Claudia, who was six months pregnant, were the targets of a burglary in 2016 (Source: Instagram/Claudia_lai_82).

Nainggolan had an extraordinary £400,000 worth of possessions taken, including 15 watches.

It was old-fashioned detective work from a local officer, Bruno Failla, which led police to a rambling home at Lurano, a small town six hours drive away in Lombardy, at which the Nikolovs would lavishly entertain other members of the Romani community.

The watches matched the descriptions of those stolen from the Nainggolans, though it was a necklace with a Roma logo, and the pair of red shoes with Nainggolan's initials, which really gave the game away.

‘I ask again for vigilance and watchfulness, please,’ Failla remarked at the time, because this was the fourth time that footballers' properties in Casal Palocco had been targeted in the space of five years. But the challenge of placing footballers in a state of constant vigilance became clear fully seven years on, when another Nainggolan residence, in Antwerp, Belgium, was burgled while his relatives held a party there.

‘It is one of the most complicated and consistently challenging parts of our security work,’ one former special forces soldier now providing security for footballers tells Daily Mail Sport. ‘It’s been a big sector of our work for years now, but the movements of these clients are so public and that’s irresistible to criminals. The wealth is very evident.’.

One of the sons, Valentino, was jailed for two years in 2016 and other members of his family also did time, but once out, they all set their sights on the Premier League. In 2024, they arrived in the UK via a ferry to Dover from Calais, stopped off in London and made their way north, sleeping in a Ford motorhome and travelling to target homes in a Citroen C3.

A spree of attacks ensued from them on the homes of Alexander Isak, then a Newcastle player, Wolves’ Matheus Cunha (who has subsequently been burgled again while at Manchester United), Birmingham City’s Neil Etheridge and Leon Bailey, with Aston Villa at the time.

A number of Premier League clubs, including Liverpool, Everton and United, are known to have appointed their own security teams to provide an around-the-clock presence at the homes of players who are in squads playing away from home – rather than have that in the hands of a range of private operators.

Some of the top football TV analysts are known to have sought the same security cover outside their houses when away at games.

A number of Premier League clubs, including Liverpool, have appointed their own security teams to provide an around-the-clock presence at the homes of stars who are playing away.

Three masked criminals managed to slip over Bruno Fernandes' security fence and into his home in Nether Alderley, Cheshire, last month and made off with jewellery.

It didn’t work in the case of Manchester United’s Bruno Fernandes. Three masked criminals still managed to slip over the security fence into his home in Nether Alderley, Cheshire, last month and make off with jewellery.

It was one of the player’s neighbours who spotted them on their CCTV system and alerted police, who arrived five minutes after the burglars had left. Some in this security sector feel that it takes the private firms' former military and special services experience to cope with the criminal gangs’ level of sophistication.

Recent findings suggest that clubs using security staff in this way is a relatively recent development. In the days of security officers like United’s Ned Kelly, who wrote a book about his 14 years with the club, the job entailed ensuring the team were protected in public, or ferrying managers and newly introduced signings around.

Sources indicate that many clubs still leave it to players. ‘Player-liaison staff will recommend vetted security providers but it’s down to player personal choice for obvious reasons,’ states one player agent.

'That's not always been easy,' says a former Premier League player-liaison officer. 'The players have a huge entourage: so-called experts who want a seat at the table and think they know best. Of course, social media enhances the security problem.'.

Industry observers note that the house burglars’ modus operandi pales by comparison with some of violence displayed by others who prey on the footballer set. One footballer's wife in Cheshire was driving a top-of-the-range vehicle when a moped took up a position in front of her and slowed. In her rear-view mirror, she saw a second. The driver of the third then arrived at her side window, assessing what there was to steal.

Sources indicate that on any given day, there could have been £200,000 worth of jewellery in the car, though she was wearing neither rings nor a watch on this occasion. The three drove off.

The episode had echoes of the attempted heist which saw Arsenal’s Mesut Ozil and Sead Kolasinac carjacked in broad daylight in north London, seven years ago.

Sead Kolasinac, then of Arsenal, thwarts an attempted carjacking in broad daylight in north London, seven years ago. Kolasinac was with his team-mate Mesut Ozil at the time.

Attackers go for Kolasinac after his car was 'boxed in' when approaching traffic lights.

Paul Hughes, managing director of Benchmark Security Group, a leading Manchester-based protection firm, employs former police and Royal security drivers to train his clients in the art of 'defensive driving'.

Industry observers note that in a two-hour session, they learn how to avoid being 'boxed in' – as Ozil and Kolasinac were – when approaching traffic lights. Techniques include never taking up a position in the middle lane, avoiding the outside lane if there is a central barrier, and always maintaining sight of the tyres of the vehicle in front when you slow.

'If you can see the tyres, you will always have room to manoeuvre right or left of the car in front, at speed, without hitting it,' Hughes indicates.

His staff are often asked to escort clients in their fleet of vehicles, which includes two Land Rovers with blacked-out windows. The firm acquired a Darkfighter Dome – a night-vision camera which is mounted on to the roof of its security vehicles – allowing them to see would-be assailants in the dark. Escorted school runs are also part of the protection they offer.

A screen which dominates Benchmark's underground headquarters, at anonymous premises in Manchester, revealed the fortresses that players' houses have become, when I visited.

Industry observers note that it highlighted live feeds from the gardens of mansions which are criss-crossed by infra-red beams. An alarm is triggered in the control room if anyone not approved through face-recognition software is picked up by up to 18 pan, tilt and zoom cameras at a property.

Recent findings suggest that loudspeakers, operated from the control room, warn off intruders. A team of security staff is never more than six minutes away. A patrol is on the scene of an alert, usually within 90 seconds.

A number of Manchester United players have invested in specialised security dogs from the Leicester-based firm Chaperone K9 at a cost of up to £20,000 each, though some sources suggest demand has receded as many players have young children. Security firms have their own dogs.

According to recent reports, benchmark are one of Britain's most trusted operators – industry-accredited, with former senior police officers on their staff. But this is also a world in which some unsavoury individuals are looking to extract gain.

It has been revealed that daily Mail Sport is aware that a number of current players have paid protection money to ensure they remain safe and are not venturing out socially without having done so. The ‘panic rooms’ some install in their homes, with security card access, are a place to hide valuables.

Sources indicate that the family who preyed on footballers for a decade will be behind bars for some time. Valentino Nikolov (pictured) is serving an initial 10-year sentence, which has since been extended.

Kolasinac fought off the carjackers. Everton's Duncan Ferguson put an assailant in hospital when he tried to burgle his home at Ormskirk, Lancashire, in January 2001. ‘I’m not a hard man off the pitch...unless you try to break into my house,’ he mentioned recently.

But the assailants in the Ozil and Kolasinac attack were part of Eastern European gangs. 'The criminal demographic has changed,' one former senior detective tells me. 'We are now talking about gangs who lack the slightest compunction about taking a life.'.

Industry observers note that the Italian family who have preyed on footballers for a decade will be behind bars for some time. The Rome lookout man’s two sons were jailed for 10 years and eight years respectively at Newcastle Crown Court last year, for burglaries including the Isak attack – sentences since extended. Their mother is doing seven years.

That court case revealed how the family had moved on from the days of old cars, screwdrivers and shinning over walls in Rome – using Isak’s own vehicle as a battering ram to force entry to his Newcastle home.

'None of the property stolen from my home was ever recovered,’ Isak related. 'The attack left me with a sense of unease and a fear it could reoccur.'.

Is attack going to be Manchester United’s best form of defence this season?

There was plenty to like going forward, particularly once United had nudged their way in front after their second lucky break of what had hitherto looked like being a tricky afternoon.

Give this team a little space and they have the attacking players to inflict some serious damage, none more so than Bruno Fernandes who, just five days after collecting the PFA Players’ Player of the Year award, scored a hat-trick in what was another inspired performance.

Ipswich Town will testify to that after a sobering second half when it felt like United were going to score with every raid forward and, for a time, even threaten to equal the nine goals they scored against the promoted side at this ground 31 years ago.

It has been revealed that in the returning Marcus Rashford, whom manager Michael Carrick likened to a “newly introduced signing”, Matheus Cunha, Bryan Mbeumo and, of course, Fernandes, United have an intriguing blend of attacking players. Throw in Kobbie Mainoo who, on another day, would have stolen the headlines with an imperious display in central midfield, and one thing United are not lacking for is creativity.

Their offensive problems tend to come when opponents sit in and ask to be broken down. Hull City, of course, proved as much last weekend when United looked desperately short of ideas in attack.

But you would probably bet on Carrick being more likely to find solutions to that particular conundrum than some of the defensive headaches that again reared their head here.

A week after that shock 2-0 defeat to Hull, United were given another scare when Ipswich took advantage of more meek defending to lead and could easily have scored more in that first half.

With a couple of days of the transfer window still remaining, it would feel remiss of United not to add a quality left-back before the deadline passes.

Those 15 minutes in the first half when Abdul Fatawu gave Luke Shaw a torrid time, not least in that moment he raced away from the United defender to cross for Leif Davis to score, should tell United’s hierarchy everything about the risks of not reinforcing in the position.

Sources indicate that ipswich STUN Old Trafford! Leif Davis does superbly to volley past Senne Lammens and give Gary O'Neil's side the lead 💥 pic.twitter.com/sJ0XNf8OiT.

It has been revealed that defensive rebuilding is next summer’s significant project but some things cannot wait and that is before we get to some of the issues in the other full-back position, which Ipswich also exploited. Fatawu aside, Daizen Maeda and Davis caused Diogo Dalot and Mbeumo problems down United’s right and the excellent Julio Enciso was a persistent nuisance until the game fell away from Ipswich.

For all the defensive concerns, though, United were exhilarating going forward, especially once they found themselves in front after benefiting from a curious ruling that dictated Harry Maguire’s “accidental” handball in the lead-up to the home team’s second goal was “not punishable” because he did not end up scoring.

In other words, had Maguire himself found the net and not seen his cross-cum-shot deflect in off the Ipswich defender Jacob Greaves, the goal would not have stood.

It has been revealed that harry Maguire's shot cannons in off Jacob Greaves and Manchester United are in front at Old Trafford after a VAR review! 💪 pic.twitter.com/hUdogDQX6k.

In a recent development, united were brilliant from that point on. There had been flashes of the threat they hold in the opening 45 minutes but thereafter Ipswich just found themselves routinely bludgeoned and unable to escape the tailspin. As the rain poured down, the goals poured in. Gary O’Neil, the Ipswich manager, talked about a lack of “emotional discipline” but plenty of teams would have found United hard to contain in that moment.

Recent findings suggest that rashford was a threat on his first start for United for 626 days. Harness his talent in the right way and he will be an enormous asset. Cunha’s withdrawn role, with Fernandes and Mbeumo routinely racing in behind United’s false nine, caused Ipswich no end of problems. Amad Diallo and Mason Mount were missing through injury and Benjamin Sesko, a substitute, is still working his way back to fitness after missing all of pre-season. Patrick Dorgu almost scored a couple after coming on. So Carrick has plenty of options.

Fernandes was at his irrepressible best, initially punishing poor Marcelino Núñez after his slip allowed Cunha to play in the United captain to equalise five minutes before the restart and then taking the game away from Ipswich in the second.

Recent findings suggest that bruno Fernandes equalises for Manchester United! 🔴 pic.twitter.com/CdEI1REeUD.

His last act was to send Mbeumo through to score with a delicious lob.

This was the first time United had scored five goals in a Premier League game since beating Leeds United five years ago and you had to go back 10 years to find the last time they had more shots in a league match.

Recent findings suggest that “There was a good mixture [in attack] there,” Carrick remarked. “Obviously we’ve got to find the right balance and options. We can play slightly different ways across the front line and a lot of the front players can play different roles.

“It was a little bit different today playing Cunha a bit deeper, and Bryan and Marcus a little bit higher. So it’s up to us to try and get that balance right, but certainly there’s creation and there’s goals within the squad, for sure.”.

Sources indicate that there was little doubt United benefited from the return of Mainoo in midfield. Summer signing Andrey Santos was the one to make way and Mainoo in turn produced the kind of intelligent, inventive display alongside Youri Tielemans that makes you wonder how Thomas Tuchel did not give the midfielder a minute for England at this summer’s World Cup.

Sources indicate that he recycles possession beautifully, excels in the tight spaces, has a nose for goal and an eye for a pass and a lovely ability to glide past players even though he is not quick. Ipswich could not live with him.

According to recent reports, asked where Mainoo could still develop, Carrick mentioned, half in jest: “On today’s performance, not much, really. I thought he was pretty much all-around, very, very good for a first start back. I understand Bruno will get a lot of credit today, and he deserves that as well, but I thought Kobbie was immense in the middle of the pitch for us and underpinned the performance of the team.”.

The Man Utd head coach told Sky Sports: “It was a good win. It was a really good win in the end. We played some really good football. The biggest thing today was the mentality of the boys tp overcomes setbacks. We’re going to have them and it depends on how you deal with them. I was really pleased with that. It’s easy to look at the result but the mentality and the stubbornness really pleased me.

“We controlled the game pretty well for the most part. A lot of our play was looking on the way to how we wanted it to look. The boys took it on really well and we were fabulous.”.

According to recent reports, and on Bruno Fernandes, Carrick added: “He showed his quality today. Bruno did what he’s good at. He’s had a big week winning awards. Three goals and a fantastic performance.

Recent findings suggest that “There were a lot of positives with and without the ball but it’s the whole mentality dealing with it and trusting each other. Last week didn’t go for us and we accept that. Today was a lot better.

“We’re not getting carried away. We were down last week but everything wasn’t wrong. We can still get better, we haven’t cracked it. We’ll get ready for the next.”.

Speaking with Sky Sports, he stated: “Really unlucky to be 2-1 down, really unlucky - two of the most unlucky goals you will see, but then not good enough to get back into it. We got punished by a very good side.

“To beat Manchester United at Old Trafford you need the moments to go in your favour and they didn’t. Rules can go against you, or a deflection, there are lots of things that can happen in a game that are beyond your control.

In a recent development, “It is a complicated rule - handball if it’s the goal scorer but not if it takes a deflection and was heading off the target. I think that is tough for a referee.

“But no problem. I’m not here to moan about refs. We get no points, at Old Trafford a lot of people leave with no points but we leave with an understanding of where to get better.

“We have three points from two tough games. A good start for us. It is the Premier League, the lads understand there will be highs and lows. We don’t want there to be too many lows but the lads are fine in there. They understand.”.

Good afternoon and welcome to our live coverage of Sunday’s late Premier League kick-off between Manchester United and Ipswich Town at Old Trafford.

Recent findings suggest that man Utd suffered an almighty upset last weekend as they slumped to a shock 2-0 defeat against Hull City in Yorkshire. The hosts scored twice after 38 minutes, leaving Michael Carrick’s men with a mountain to climb, but they simply had no answer so Man Utd were shambolic defensively and toothless in attack.

It has been revealed that when the fixture list was released, everyone looked at Man Utd’s opening two games against newly-promoted sides as the ideal opportunity for maximum points. But now, there is serious pressure on today’s home team to deliver in front of their fans.

Sources indicate that reflecting on last week’s loss in a press conference ahead of this outing, Carrick said: “I think your success comes from how well you deal with setbacks in the end. In any position, or certainly any sport, particularly this one, going through a season, there are going to be setbacks, sometimes a bit smaller than others. It’s how you deal with that initially, how you react to it and what comes next. I think that ultimately decides what type of team you’re going to become.

“So far, we’ve dealt with those setbacks really well within games and game to game. We had one last week, there’s no getting away from it, and it’s disappointing, but we’re looking to bounce back. We’ve had a good week. The boys have re-focused, learnt from where we could have improved and kept pushing forward.”.

Recent findings suggest that against the odds, Ipswich began their 2026-27 Premier League campaign with a 2-1 comeback victory over Sunderland, with summer signing Emersonn equalising before substitute Jack Clarke found a 90th-minute winner at Portman Road. They followed this game with another triumph at home in midweek, beating Leicester City 3-1 in the League Cup second round.

With all eyes on Man Utd after their stuttering start, Ipswich will see this as an ideal opportunity to ruffle the feathers of a Premier League heavyweight and further dent their sky-high ambitions.

Kick-off is at 16:30, with team news coming shortly.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

According to recent reports, la bellissima vittoria contro il Frosinone dovrebbe far riflettere su cosa serva al Milan in vista del mercato di gennaio. Il test contro i ciociari è stato superato brillantemente, ma è giusto pensare di potenziale l’organico per avere più chance di arrivare nelle prime quattro. Cosa manca al Milan titolare visto contro il Frosinone? Uno dei ruoli scoperti è quello del terzino sinistro. Pervis Estupinan è sempre più ai margini, non è in fiducia e potrebbe partire durante la finestra invernale. Davide Bartesaghi viene visto dal tecnico portoghese più come esterno alto che difensore puro, e infatti in quella posizione spesso va in difficoltà. Dunque Amorim per correre ai ripari, sia a Genova che nel secondo tempo contro il Frosinone, ha dovuto schierare Musah terzino a sinistro. Ciò rappresenta un’anomalia. Quindi a gennaio il Milan lavorerà per prendere un terzino sinistro, come vera priorità.

Industry observers note that L’altra priorità riguarda il centrale. Qui però il Diavolo deve cercare di recuperare prima possibile Pavlovic, alle prese con questo fastidio al rene che non lo fa essere ancora al 100%. A gennaio potrebbe rientrare Gabbia ma serve un altro elemento di qualità per consentire di ruotare con maggiore serenità. Amorim ha dichiarato che Gonçalo Inacio non è vicino al Milan, nonostante apprezzi tanto il centrale dello Sporting. E ha ribadito che probabilmente andranno rinforzati altri ruoli (appunto il terzino è tra queste priorità).

Sources indicate that veniamo al caso Endrick. Il Milan ci proverà. Il proprietario Gerry Cardinale ha ottimi rapporti con Roc Nation e ne stanno parlando. L’ostacolo vero è Mourinho. L’ex Inter si è esposto pubblicamente dicendo che si opporrà fino alla fine sulla cessione del giocatore. Ma è una possibile operazione da tenere in considerazione.

Passando all’aspetto dirigenziale, si può finalmente dire che Markus Krösche sarà il prossimo dirigente dei rossoneri. Ieri il Milan e l’Eintracht Francoforte si sono sentiti per anticipare l’uscita del manager tedesco. I club di via Aldo Rossi verserà un indennizzo di 4 milioni per avere Krosche. L’obiettivo è annunciarlo in questa settimana, e averlo pronto per dicembre quando comincerà a lavorare sul mercato di gennaio. Finalmente anche questa lunga telenovela si concluderà. La presenza di un manager di calcio è importantissima, a patto che abbia spazio per operare, naturalmente in accordo con l’allenatore. Il fatto che il Milan si stia strutturando è sicuramente un fattore positivo.

In a recent development, la chiusura la dedichiamo ad Adrien Rabiot. Il suo miglior inizio di stagione di sempre. Da sette partite di fila è decisivo in termini di gol e assist in serie A, e si vede che ha una maturità al di sopra della media. In alcune partite dà l’impressione di giocare con gli occhi chiusi, di divertirsi in questa squadra e con questo allenatore. Rabiot è vicino al rinnovo e sarà fondamentale per il Milan blindarlo. Insieme a Pulisic, Moreira e Modric rappresenta un pilastro di questa squadra.

La partita tra Atalanta e Inter, valida per la 12a giornata di Serie A, è terminata con un pareggio.

A Bergamo, nella dodicesima giornata di Serie A, Atalanta e Inter hanno regalato una partita molto combattuta e terminata con un 4-4.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

La squadra di Cristian Chivu era partita fortissimo trascinata da una super tripletta di Pio Esposito (16', 32' e 52') e sembrava avere la gara in pugno, anche dopo il rigore trasformato da Sučić (76') per il momentaneo 2-4. Ma l'Atalanta di Maurizio Sarri non ha mai mollato: prima ha accorciato con Elmas (35') e con la doppietta di Charles De Ketelaere (72' e 81'), e poi nel recupero ha trovato il clamoroso pareggio su rigore con Franck Kessié (90'+1').

Con questo pareggio l'Inter lascia per strada due punti pesanti e resta al terzo posto con 29 punti e alle spalle della Lazio capolista a quota 32 punti e della Roma seconda a 30.

Uno dei contratti in scadenza il 30 giugno 2027 è quello di Hakan Calhanoglu, colonna della squadra ed elemento insostituibile, ma che guadagna molto (6,5 milioni di euro a stagione), che ha già superato i 30 anni (a febbraio saranno 33) e che sta accusando sempre più problemi fisici (l'ultimo, ieri sera contro l'Atalanta). Un'offerta non è ancora arrivata, ma sarà probabilmente rispedita al mittente, seppur la priorità sia quella di rimanere in Italia. Una situazione che potrebbe far drizzare le antenne a numerosi club: su tutti, Juventus e Como in Italia, oltre al "solito" Galatasaray e al Tottenham.

Recent findings suggest that (ANSA) - NAPOLI, 23 NOV - Le brutte sensazioni di Antonio Vergara sono confermate dagli esami strumentali svolti al Pineta Grande Hospital: per il centrocampista del Napoli, infortunatosi nel corso del match di sabato sera contro il Torino al Maradona, è stata evidenziata una lesione di alto grado del bicipite femorale della coscia sinistra. A darne notizia è il club partenopeo in un comunicato ufficiale in cui non vengono fatte stime sui tempi di recupero del calciatore azzurro che nel frattempo ha già iniziato l'iter riabilitativo. Si ipotizza che possa ritornare disponibile nel 2027. Nel frattempo, alla vigilia della sfida di Champions League con il Manchester City, la squadra guidata da Massimiliano Allegri si è allenata al Ssc Napoli Training Center prima della partenza per l'Inghilterra.

Industry observers note that il gruppo è stato impegnato in una seduta mattutina svolgendo attivazione e lavoro tecnico-tattico. Anche David Neres, in via di rientro dopo l'infortunio, ha svolto l'intera sessione con i compagni. (ANSA).

#153001. Inside Newcastle United's transfer tension: Matthias Jaissle wants greater control as he eyes a new No 10 and No 9 in January - but the next four fixtures could make or break him and the club's season, writes CRAIG HOPE
